facts.text: The Company's objective is to invest all of its free cash flow available to shareholders (FCFA2S) in acquisitions which meet the Company's hurdle rate.

facts.item: Mandatory conversion of preferred and special shares
facts.text: All preferred shares and special shares issued by Lumine Group in connection with its 2023 spin-off were automatically converted into subordinate voting shares effective March 25, 2024, with an aggregate of 189,114,308 subordinate voting shares issued plus 3,515,418 additional shares for accrued dividends. Since then Lumine has had no outstanding preferred or special shares.
facts.source_title: Lumine Group Inc. Completes Mandatory Conversion of its Preferred Shares and Special Shares

facts.item: Constellation Software ownership and control of Lumine (current)
facts.text: As at March 31, 2026, Constellation Software holds 157,553,539 Lumine Subordinate Voting Shares, an equity interest of 61.40% in Lumine, with a non-controlling interest of 38.60%. Constellation controls Lumine and consolidates Lumine's financial position and results of operations.
facts.source_title: Constellation Software Inc. Management's Discussion and Analysis Q1 2026

facts.text: David Nyland is Founder and CEO of Lumine Group. He began his career as a software developer, held COO roles at Architel Systems (now Oracle) and Syndesis (now Netcracker/NEC), and was President & CEO of NBS Technologies from 2003 to 2006 and CEO of Blueprint Software Systems. He joined Constellation's Volaris operating group in 2014 to build the communications and media business that became Lumine, and has been CEO & Director of Lumine Group since 2022; Lumine spun out of Constellation in 2023. He attended Brunel University of London.

facts.item: Mary Anne Lavallee appointed Lumine CFO
facts.text: Mary Anne Lavallee was appointed Chief Financial Officer of Lumine Group, effective May 26, 2025.
facts.source_title: Lumine Group Inc. Announces New CFO Appointment

facts.item: Lumine board members tied to Constellation Software
facts.text: Lumine Group's board includes Mark Miller (President & COO of Constellation Software, CEO of Volaris Group, and Chairman of Lumine's board), Brian Beattie (CFO of Volaris Group, and a prior CFO of Lumine, now a director), Robin van Poelje (CEO of Topicus.com), and David Nyland (CEO of Lumine Group).
facts.source_title: Leadership Team Driving Global Software Growth - CSI Software

facts.text: Lumine describes itself as a global network of 30+ companies across 50+ countries serving 1000+ communications and media customers, with 3,500+ employees; workforce is distributed roughly North America 33%, Europe excluding UK 27%, Asia Pacific 23%, and UK 9%.

facts.item: AI as a core capability (mid-2025 letter)
facts.text: In his 2025 mid-year letter, CEO David Nyland described AI as no longer a buzzword at Lumine but a core capability driving innovation across its ecosystem, citing concrete product innovations such as Openwave's 'AI Smart Assistant.'
facts.source_title: Reflecting on the First Half of 2025: A Letter from David Nyland, CEO, Lumine Group

facts.item: AI Impact CEO Summit and portfolio-wide AI use cases
facts.text: Lumine hosted its 3rd Impact CEO Summit focused on AI, where leaders across the portfolio identified more than 600 real-world AI augmentation use cases across portfolio companies; the first half of 2026 also deepened Lumine's view of where AI fits across the portfolio alongside three acquisitions completed in H1.
facts.source_title: A Mid-Year Message from David Nyland - Lumine Group

facts.item: Highest organic growth in three years (Q1 2026, pre-FX)
facts.text: In Q1 2026, Lumine achieved its highest organic growth performance, pre-FX, for the past three years, according to the CEO's mid-year message.
facts.source_title: A Mid-Year Message from David Nyland - Lumine Group

facts.text: Lumine Group's April 2024 agreement to acquire Casa Systems' Axyom Cloud Native 5G Core Software & RAN assets was described as marking Lumine Group's 14th corporate carve-out.
facts.source_title: Lumine Group Enters into an Agreement to Acquire Casa Systems' Axyom Cloud Native 5G Core Software & RAN Assets
